facts.fact: Lorraine 告诉 Soren：Kit 已经三天没好好吃东西了，她本想他也许能吃下三明治。
facts.anchor: He’s not eaten properly for about three days,” she says. “I thought he might manage a sandwich.

facts.fact: Soren 心情恶劣，说随他饿着：要么死，要么终于长大肯吃她的饭。
facts.anchor: So let him starve. He’ll either die or finally grow up and eat your food.

facts.fact: Lorraine 反驳：他只是难受，因为不知道不动刑怎么让 Kit 这样的人开口。
facts.anchor: You’re just miserable because you don’t know how to make someone like Kit talk without resorting to torture.

facts.fact: Soren 说留 Kit 是为了不让他落到很坏的人手里被利用、折磨、操纵。
facts.anchor: So he doesn’t end up being used, or tortured, or manipulated by… very bad people.

facts.fact: Lorraine 追问：你 Soren Sinclair 为什么在乎？
facts.anchor: And why do you, Soren Sinclair… care?

facts.fact: Soren 内心承认下不去手：那是不知父母卷了何事的无辜二十岁孩子，听他声音就发抖。
facts.anchor: Not to an innocent twenty-year-old kid who had no idea what his parents were mixed up in. Not to the terrified boy who flinches at the sound of my voice.

facts.fact: Soren 想：如果 Everly 家没有孩子，事情会容易得多。
facts.anchor: it would have been much easier if the Everlys didn’t have a child.

facts.fact: 口交途中 Kit 的脸毫无预警闯进来：惊恐的绿眼睛、黑卷发、纤细手指、秒顺从。
facts.anchor: Then an image hits me without warning… Kit’s face. Those wide, scared, green eyes. The thick black curls falling over his forehead. The way his delicate fingers always fidget when he’s nervous. That small frame that looks like it could break if someone breathed on it too hard. The instant, quiet obedience every single time he’s spoken to.

facts.fact: Soren 走近唤 Christopher，Kit 猛转身、玻璃杯脱手摔碎、人立刻慌了。
facts.anchor: He turns sharply, eyes going wide the second they lock onto mine, just for a brief second, before a strangled little noise escapes his throat. The glass slips from his fingers and shatters against the floor; he panics instantly.

facts.fact: Soren 发现他手侧细小伤口，不假思索抓住手腕下令 Stay。
facts.anchor: I spot the thin cut along the side of his hand before he can escape and reach out without thinking, closing my fingers around his wrist.

facts.fact: Soren 替他贴创可贴，惊觉自己从没给人贴过，正像看护者一样捧着孩子的手。
facts.anchor: I don’t usually put band-aids on people, in fact… I never have. Why the fuck did I just do that? I keep hold of his hand, frowning down at it for several long seconds, before the realisation hits me… I’m standing here cradling the kid’s hand like some kind of caretaker.

facts.fact: Soren 俯身到耳边得意地让 Kit 再说一次，对方声音更清楚地说了 Thank you。
facts.anchor: He inhales shakily. When he speaks again his voice is still soft, but clearer. “Thank you.”

facts.fact: 越轨念头冒出：他会不会比我玩的女人更听话？画面成形他僵住、后颈发热。
facts.anchor: The second the images form I go still

facts.fact: 章末 Soren 承认从没和男人睡过，但这念头并不像预期那样令人不安。
facts.anchor: I’ve never slept with a guy before. I expected the idea itself to feel more unsettling than it does, but it doesn’t, at all.
